items.quote: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when thou numberest them.
items.claim: The text says that when the Israelites are counted in a census, every man must pay a ransom for his soul to the LORD so that no plague comes on them during the count.
items.actor: every man of the children of Israel
items.action: give a ransom for his soul unto the LORD
items.object: census (taking the sum of the children of Israel)
items.mechanism: The ransom paid at the census is presented as protection against a plague tied to the act of counting.

items.quote: 30:11 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The text presents the census-ransom rule as a direct instruction from the LORD to Moses.
items.mechanism: The rule is given authority by being framed as speech from God.
